jobs.description: Looking for a job with good working hours, nice pay, and free weekends? Say no more! Come work as a warehouse packer at Leerdam Crisal Glass (LCG) in Gorinchem. You will start with a salary of € 14.99 per hour (+21) while working alongside energetic colleagues. After a year, you will get a pay raise to € 16,19 per hour (+22)! Sound like your next challenge? Apply right away and secure this job! 🥳What we offer- Starting salary of € 14,99 gross per hour! (+21)- Pay raise to € 16.19 per hour after 1 year! (+22)- Day shifts on weekdays, evenings + weekends free!- Nice travel allowance of € 0.23 per km!- Working in an international, fun team!- You can start working quickly at LCG!Who you areTo keep our warehouse running smoothly, you meet the following objective requirements:- You are available to work 3 to 5 days a week from Monday to Friday- You are available for the day shift from 07:30 to 16:15- You live in the Gorinchem region or have your own transport to get to the location- You can communicate effectively in English or Dutch- You are physically capable of packing items efficiently at a standing deskWhat will you doAs a warehouse packer, you play a vital role in shipping glassware to major clients like IKEA! The glassware is produced in Leerdam and transported to our logistics warehouse in Gorinchem. Using a clear manual, you pack the items into boxes and stack them onto pallets. After that, your colleague on the forklift takes over. You get to work hard while enjoying nice conversations with your team. Easy peasy! Tadaaa! 📦Your key responsibilities as a warehouse packer:- Packing drinking glasses quickly and carefully according to instructions- Stacking packed boxes neatly onto pallets for transport- Maintaining an organized and safe workspace together with your colleaguesWhere will you workYou will be joining an international distribution center in Gorinchem as our new warehouse packer!
